headline: Mafia City of Lost Heaven
title: Mafia The City of Lost Heaven Facts | Gangster Classic | Classic Games
video_script: Mafia The City of Lost Heaven arrived in two thousand two, made by the Czech studio Illusion Softworks. Its fictional city, Lost Heaven, borrows from New York, Chicago and Los Angeles. Around sixty cars are based on real nineteen twenties and thirties models, renamed for trademark reasons. In two thousand twenty, the Definitive Edition remake launched. Did you finish the race mission? Comment below!
